summary: Bearer is Resistant to one School chosen at casting (Death, Flame, Subdual, Command or Sorcery); outside the Enchantment limit; no other (m) Protection Enchantments.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Resistant: unaffected by the next ability from the chosen School.

restrictions.note: Unless the other Protection Enchantment is (ex).

termination.note: Resistant means unaffected by the next effect of the type (Resistant definition); the text does not say the strip is removed.

properties.note: School chosen at the time of casting from Death, Flame, Subdual, Command, Sorcery.

clarifications.text: The School is chosen at the time of casting.
May be worn alongside Protection School Enchantments that are (ex), but not with (m) ones.

open_questions: E2 does not say who chooses the School (caster or bearer); 'at the time of casting' suggests the caster.
Whether the Enchantment is removed once the Resistance is used is not stated in the text.
